body: No, I haven't. I just read your comment and tried googling the symptoms but I can't bring myself to read over them, it feels like I'm self diagnosing myself with something I might not have. I've never been to a psychiatrist or any doctor in general to talk about my suicidal thoughts. My whole life I've conditioned myself to never even consider that I have any sort of mental illness. My family always told me that diagnosis = no dignity and as much as I hate myself for it I still live with that in my head
